versions.changelog:
Initial release of huawei-cloud-sms-migration-assistant.

- Provides an end-to-end assistant for host migration to Huawei Cloud using SMS, including host info retrieval, migration preparation, agent startup, migration task creation, error troubleshooting, progress monitoring, and user notification on replication completion.
- Emphasizes strict source protection and outlines prohibited high-risk operations to ensure data integrity and migration success.
- Details required pre-migration checks, SMS agent installation steps, and comprehensive migration API workflow.
- Includes precise naming and EIP/network handling rules for migrated resources.
- Supplies post-migration validation procedures and common error fixes.
- Describes full post-migration recovery process for incompatible systems.
